nom: Sun Bum Mini Original SPF 45 Sunscreen Face Mist

avis.texte: Great product! It was easy to apply and kept my face from burning. Usually, I burn an hour into the sun but with this product I did not! It's great quality! I highly recommend buying.
Great size, perfect to keep in my bag for on the go sun protection! WEAR YOUR SUNSCREEN
Best face spray protection out there! Doesn't hurt your eyes and smells great
The small bottle is handy for reapplication on the go! Love the scent. I didn't really sweat enough to have any running in my eyes, but had no issues with burning on the skin.
This travel size face mist is perfect size to have in my bag for all the constant trips.
the stinkin best! i love the smell and the way it feels on my skin. it makes me want to reapply : )
Love the Sun Bum products, I have given 2 Sun Bum travel kits as gifts, everyone is ecstatict when receiving the kit, and I am looking forward to buying more products!

When you sweat if runs into your b eyes and is the worst burn ever. Doesn't even go away when you flush it out. So unbelievably painful. Is nice to use on on back of hands and top of feet. Wanted to love it for its slim design & that it us easy to travel with
Works amazing! Goes on over makeup! Looks and feels great. The smell reminds me of childhood.

I love this mist! It's light, doesn't feel greasy or sticky, and only a couple spritzes are needed. The smell is a little different than the usual scent but I love it just as much if not more! So beachy!
This got into my eyes when spraying on my face and they immediatly turned red and puffy! Absolutely not it also broke me out terribly please stay away!

I love this refresher spray. Plus, it has SPF. I mean, I don't count on that for the amount of SPF I need, but it's a bonus. If you don't like scent, this isn't for you, but I love it! It doesn't stay strong, but every time I spray it, someone comments how great it smells.
I LOVE THE SPRAY. but not sure if its my fave daily sunscreen. I like a lotion sunscreen but this is convenient. Smells like all other sunbum products (banana/summer) and i layer diff spf products.

avis.titre: Love the mist rather than the spray
avis.texte: I use spf makeup but this is perfect to carry and apply when im oitside with out ruin my hair or makeup
It clogs my pores and causes me to break out. This is especially when I sweat. I try to use it sometimes though. I can't waster it.

I utilize Sun Bum Face Mist & spray Sunscreen to protect my skin year round from the intense sunshine here in southern New Mexico! Their products are light, non greasy and keep my skin hydrated & nicely tan. I use them everyday I am outdoors riding my mtn bike or working in the yard. Thank you for excellent skin care products!

I've tried several sun bum products but this one is not one I would recommend. The worst part about this one is that I found that when it got to hot and I started to sweat it would run into my eyes, it happened on multiple occasions which isn't great for a suncare product. I am going to finish the bottle by using it on my arms, but this is not a great option for my face. The only thing I like about it is it was a nice idea to have a spray sunscreen that isn't in an aerosol can.

Love this face SPF mist for a nice cooling effect. Recently went on a beach vacay. I used this product throught the day. I could pull it out of my bag and quickly get my SPF protection with a clean clear light mist. It was cooling as well which was a great plus in the hot climate. A light tropical scent that dissipates quickly. So glad i had this. Works great. I would definitely encourage others to purchase if just for the ease of use. I sprayed over makeup too. This is a great performance product.
Smells strongly of fake banana, burned the skin while applying, left me feeling sticky and greasy.
